scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @networkchum/shared && npm run build --workspace @networkchum/api && npm run build --workspace @networkchum/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/start.test.mjs scripts/doctor.test.mjs scripts/serve-web.test.mjs scripts/systemd-unit.test.mjs scripts/web-bind.test.mjs scripts/install.test.mjs tools/native-console-bridge/server.test.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,bridge "npm run dev --workspace @networkchum/api" "npm run dev --workspace @networkchum/web" "npm run dev:bridge"
scripts.dev:reset: pkill -f "tsx watch src/server.ts"; pkill -f "vite --port 5173 --strictPort"; npm run dev
